items.source: The Spring Framework provides first-class support for integration testing in the spring-test module. The name of the actual JAR file might include the release version and might also be in the long org.springframework.test form, depending on where you get it from (see the section on Dependency Management for an explanation). This library includes the org.springframework.test package, which contains valuable classes for integration testing with a Spring container. This testing does not rely on an application server or other deployment environment. Such tests are slower to run than unit tests but much faster than the equivalent Selenium tests or remote tests that rely on deployment to an application server.
items.translation: Spring Framework 在 spring-test 模块中提供了一流的集成测试支持。实际的 JAR 文件名可能包含发布版本，并且根据获取来源的不同，也可能采用较长的 org.springframework.test 形式（有关解释请参阅依赖管理部分）。该库包含了 org.springframework.test 包，其中含有用于与 Spring 容器进行集成测试的宝贵类。此类测试不依赖于应用服务器或其他部署环境。与单元测试相比，这类测试运行速度较慢，但比需要部署到应用服务器的等效 Selenium 测试或远程测试快得多。

items.source: The Spring TestContext Framework provides consistent loading of Spring ApplicationContext instances and WebApplicationContext instances as well as caching of those contexts. Support for the caching of loaded contexts is important, because startup time can become an issue — not because of the overhead of Spring itself, but because the objects instantiated by the Spring container take time to instantiate. For example, a project with 50 to 100 Hibernate mapping files might take 10 to 20 seconds to load the mapping files, and incurring that cost before running every test in every test fixture leads to slower overall test runs that reduce developer productivity.
items.translation: Spring TestContext Framework 提供了一致的 Spring ApplicationContext 实例和 WebApplicationContext 实例的加载方式，并支持对这些上下文进行缓存。对已加载上下文的缓存支持非常重要，因为启动时间可能成为一个问题——这并非由于 Spring 本身的开销，而是因为由 Spring 容器实例化的对象需要时间来创建。例如，一个拥有 50 到 100 个 Hibernate 映射文件的项目可能需要 10 到 20 秒来加载这些映射文件；如果在每个测试夹具中运行每个测试之前都承担这一成本，会导致整体测试运行速度变慢，从而降低开发者的生产力。

items.source: See Context Management and Context Caching with the TestContext framework.
items.translation: 请参阅 上下文管理 和 上下文缓存，以了解 TestContext 框架。

items.translation: 例如，考虑一个场景，其中我们有一个类（HibernateTitleRepository），它实现了针对 Title 领域实体的数据访问逻辑。我们要编写集成测试来测试以下方面：

items.source: If you want a transaction to commit (unusual, but occasionally useful when you want a particular test to populate or modify the database), you can tell the TestContext framework to cause the transaction to commit instead of roll back by using the @Commit annotation.
items.translation: 如果您希望事务提交（虽然不常见，但在需要特定测试填充或修改数据库时偶尔有用），可以使用 @Commit 注解告诉 TestContext 框架提交事务而不是回滚。

items.source: A JdbcTemplate, for executing SQL statements to query the database. You can use such queries to confirm database state both before and after execution of database-related application code, and Spring ensures that such queries run in the scope of the same transaction as the application code. When used in conjunction with an ORM tool, be sure to avoid false positives.
items.translation: 一个用于执行 SQL 语句以查询数据库的JdbcTemplate。您可以使用此类查询来确认在执行数据库相关应用程序代码之前和之后的数据库状态，并且 Spring 确保此类查询在与应用程序代码相同的事务范围内运行。当与 ORM 工具结合使用时，请务必避免误报。

items.source: Unit and integration testing support is provided in the form of the annotation-driven Spring TestContext Framework. The TestContext framework is agnostic of the actual testing framework in use, which allows instrumentation of tests in various environments, including JUnit, TestNG, and others.
items.translation: 单元测试和集成测试支持以注解驱动的Spring TestContext Framework的形式提供。TestContext 框架与所使用的实际测试框架无关，这允许在各种环境中对测试进行增强，包括 JUnit、TestNG 等。

items.source: Test classes typically declare either an array of resource locations for XML or Groovy configuration metadata — often in the classpath — or an array of component classes that is used to configure the application. These locations or classes are the same as or similar to those specified in web.xml or other configuration files for production deployments.
items.translation: 测试类通常声明一个用于 XML 或 Groovy 配置元数据的资源位置数组——通常位于类路径中——或者一个用于配置应用程序的组件类数组。这些位置或类与生产部署中在 web.xml 或其他配置文件中所指定的相同或相似。

items.source: By default, once loaded, the configured ApplicationContext is reused for each test. Thus, the setup cost is incurred only once per test suite, and subsequent test execution is much faster. In this context, the term “test suite” means all tests run in the same JVM — for example, all tests run from an Ant, Maven, or Gradle build for a given project or module. In the unlikely case that a test corrupts the application context and requires reloading (for example, by modifying a bean definition or the state of an application object) the TestContext framework can be configured to reload the configuration and rebuild the application context before executing the next test.
items.translation: 默认情况下，加载后配置的 ApplicationContext 会在每个测试中重复使用。因此，设置成本仅在每次测试套件中产生一次，随后的测试执行速度会快得多。在此上下文中，“测试套件”指的是在同一 JVM 中运行的所有测试——例如，为给定项目或模块从 Ant、Maven 或 Gradle 构建中运行的所有测试。在不太可能的情况下，如果测试破坏了应用程序上下文并需要重新加载（例如，通过修改 bean 定义或应用程序对象的状态），则可以配置 TestContext 框架以在下一次测试执行之前重新加载配置并重建应用程序上下文。

items.source: When the TestContext framework loads your application context, it can optionally configure instances of your test classes by using Dependency Injection. This provides a convenient mechanism for setting up test fixtures by using preconfigured beans from your application context. A strong benefit here is that you can reuse application contexts across various testing scenarios (for example, for configuring Spring-managed object graphs, transactional proxies, DataSource instances, and others), thus avoiding the need to duplicate complex test fixture setup for individual test cases.
items.translation: 当 TestContext 框架加载您的应用程序上下文时，它可以可选地使用依赖注入配置您的测试类实例。这提供了一种使用来自您应用程序上下文的预配置 Bean 来设置测试夹具的便捷机制。这里的一个主要好处是，您可以在各种测试场景（例如，用于配置 Spring 管理的对象图、事务代理、DataSource 实例等）之间重用应用程序上下文，从而避免为各个测试用例重复复杂的测试夹具设置。

items.source: The Spring configuration: Basically, is everything related to the configuration of the HibernateTitleRepository bean correct and present?
items.translation: Spring 配置：基本上，与 HibernateTitleRepository Bean 配置相关的所有内容是否正确且存在？

items.source: The logic of the HibernateTitleRepository: Does the configured instance of this class perform as anticipated?
items.translation: HibernateTitleRepository 的逻辑：配置的该类的实例是否按预期运行？

items.source: See dependency injection of test fixtures with the TestContext framework.
items.translation: 通过 TestContext 框架 查看测试夹具的依赖注入。

items.source: The TestContext framework addresses this issue. By default, the framework creates and rolls back a transaction for each test. You can write code that can assume the existence of a transaction. If you call transactionally proxied objects in your tests, they behave correctly, according to their configured transactional semantics. In addition, if a test method deletes the contents of selected tables while running within the transaction managed for the test, the transaction rolls back by default, and the database returns to its state prior to execution of the test. Transactional support is provided to a test by using a PlatformTransactionManager bean defined in the test’s application context.
items.translation: TestContext 框架解决了这一问题。默认情况下，该框架为每个测试创建并回滚事务。您可以编写代码来假定事务的存在。如果在测试中调用事务代理对象，它们将根据其配置的事务语义正确运行。此外，如果测试方法在由测试管理的事务期间删除选定表的内容，则事务将默认回滚，数据库恢复到测试执行前的状态。通过使用在测试的应用上下文中定义的 PlatformTransactionManager Bean，为测试提供事务支持。

items.source: See transaction management with the TestContext framework.
items.translation: 查看使用 TestContext 框架 的事务管理。

items.source: The Spring TestContext Framework provides several abstract support classes that simplify the writing of integration tests. These base test classes provide well-defined hooks into the testing framework as well as convenient instance variables and methods, which let you access:
items.translation: Spring TestContext 框架提供了几个abstract支持类，可简化集成测试的编写。这些基础测试类提供了对测试框架的明确挂钩，以及方便的实例变量和方法，让您能够访问：

items.source: The ApplicationContext, for performing explicit bean lookups or testing the state of the context as a whole.
items.translation: ApplicationContext 用于执行显式的 Bean 查找或测试整个上下文的状态。

items.source: See support classes for the TestContext framework.
items.translation: 请参阅TestContext 框架的支持类。

Doing so lets you test things such as:

items.translation: 您的 Spring IoC 容器上下文的正确接线。

items.source:
Data access using JDBC or an ORM tool. This can include such things as the correctness
of SQL statements, Hibernate queries, JPA entity mappings, and so forth.
items.translation: 使用 JDBC 或 ORM 工具进行数据访问。这可能包括 SQL 语句的正确性、Hibernate 查询、JPA 实体映射等内容。

items.source:
The following section provides an overview of the high-level goals of Spring’s
integration support, and the rest of this chapter then focuses on dedicated topics:
items.translation: 本节概述了 Spring 集成支持的高级目标，本章其余部分则专注于专门的主题：

items.source: Spring’s integration testing support has the following primary goals:
items.translation: Spring 的集成测试支持具有以下主要目标：

items.source:
The next few sections describe each goal and provide links to implementation and
configuration details.
items.translation: 接下来的几个部分将描述每个目标，并提供指向实现和配置详情的链接。

items.source:
The Hibernate mapping file configuration: Is everything mapped correctly and are the
correct lazy-loading settings in place?
items.translation: Hibernate 映射文件配置：是否已正确映射所有内容，并设置了正确的懒加载选项？

items.source:
One common issue in tests that access a real database is their effect on the state of the
persistence store. Even when you use a development database, changes to the state may
affect future tests. Also, many operations — such as inserting or modifying persistent
data — cannot be performed (or verified) outside of a transaction.
items.translation: 访问真实数据库的测试中，一个常见问题是它们对持久化存储状态的影响。即使使用开发数据库，状态的更改也可能影响未来的测试。此外，许多操作（例如插入或修改持久数据）无法在事务之外执行（或验证）。

items.source:
In addition, you may want to create your own custom, application-wide superclass with
instance variables and methods specific to your project.
items.translation: 此外，您可能希望创建一个自定义的、适用于整个应用程序的超类，其中包含特定于您项目的实例变量和方法。
